notes: Typed text now has line spacing and letter spacing, so text added to a form can sit on its printed lines or one letter to a box. Fixes a fault where the window could be replaced by "Something broke: The quota has been exceeded" after working with pictures for a while. On macOS 10.15 Catalina, a page's selectable text no longer shows on top of the page and dark mode works. The recovery window closes by itself after recovering unsaved work.
